deployment.warning: Device Proxy reports 6 container restarts, last exit code 1, although its current phase is Running.

publisher.behavior: Published 20 T01 ego frames at 20 Hz, then wrote 0/0/0 and became a no-op.

live_readback.interpretation: No C1/C2 publisher is currently producing fresh decisions. The latest ego timestamps and null output timestamps are from 2026-08-07, not the audit time.

custom_artifact.name: dms-driver-safety-vss
custom_artifact.binding_state: Not bound to any of the 11 visible blueprints; the active broker still uses the stock VSS artifact.
custom_artifact.api_limit: The documented OpenAPI exposes artifact/version metadata but no file-content download endpoint. The 0.0.6 definitions cannot be audited through that API alone.

members.address: DHCP/runtime, not stored in the blueprint

ivi_segment.optional_script_target: 10.99.0.3:55555 is the optional AGL guest described in IVI Gateway source; it is not the Android address.

network_topology.hmi_requirement: A new HTTP/UDP HMI bridge intended to reach Android must join IVI Switch. Attaching it only to TCU Switch cannot reach Android in the exported topology.
network_topology.runtime_ip_probe: Blocked: container-exec returned HTTP 502 because Conduit is not configured. Static blueprint addresses are verified; DHCP addresses are not.

android.tunnel_discovery: GET adb-tunnel returned HTTP 200, one Running Skycraft node, and a non-null conduit URL.
android.command_transport: Both adb-exec and VM shell returned HTTP 502 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Conduit service not configured.
android.conclusion: Screen streaming is available through the widget, but API-driven ADB installation/control is not currently usable. A non-null tunnel URL is not sufficient proof of ADB readiness.

container_and_registry.registry_convention: Deployed containers pull from the cluster-local registry namespace localhost:5000.
container_and_registry.openapi_limit: The supplied OpenAPI has no container registry login, build, push, or image-upload endpoint.
container_and_registry.runtime_exec: Both IVI Gateway and TCU-NAD read-only container-exec probes returned HTTP 502 because Conduit is not configured.
container_and_registry.required_external_step: Provision the SafeLoop image through the CarSky-supported registry/UI/admin workflow before a container node can deploy it.

api_limits_and_headroom.source: GET /api/v1/config/limits; account-specific effective endpoints returned 401/403, so these are advertised platform values, not a proven per-account override.

clean_clone.reason: It preserves the working Android, VHAL, KUKSA, CAN, and both Ethernet segments but contains neither the 20 Hz probe nor the mock publisher.
clean_clone.target_state: PUBLISHED, PRIVATE, unlocked, no active deployment, no widgets

blocking_constraints: There is no fresh C1/C2 model output in the active broker; only a completed one-shot ego probe remains.
The custom VSS artifact exists but is not bound to any blueprint, and its file body cannot be fetched through the documented API.

Batch/addPin and portable import schemas do not accept legacy ETHERNET or USB pin types, although exported blueprints contain them. A new HMI bridge cannot be wired to IVI Ethernet through the documented batch/import contract alone.
The node PATCH route is documented but previously returned 404 in this tenant; it must be tested on the new clone before relying on broker, gateway, or container reconfiguration.
ADB, VM shell, and container exec are all blocked by Conduit misconfiguration despite tunnel metadata being present.
No documented registry API exists for uploading the real SafeLoop image.
